titre: Frais de virement du premier trimestre : la proposition v3 et le brouillon d'avis aux clients disent 0,40 %, un message Slack plus récent dit 0,45 % ; le premier résultat est le document périmé

passages.texte:
Proposal v3 (for leadership review)
Payout fee: 0.40% per payout (today 0.50%), minimum $0.25
Volume tiers: −0.05 pt above $5M/month, −0.10 pt above $20M/month
Effective January 1, 2027 for all customers. Tradewell keeps its contracted rate until December 2027.
Heads-up team: after Gil's review the Q1 payout fee is 0.45%, not 0.40% 🙏 the v3 deck is outdated, please don't send it to anyone. Tiers unchanged. Customer notices go out by Dec 1.
oops, I already told Pinecrest 0.40% on their QBR. will correct it with Rob this week

Owen Park: For Q1 we're looking at bringing the payout fee down to 0.40%, with volume tiers on top.
Rob Delgado: That would help. We're at about 22k payouts a month and growing.

[DRAFT – do not send]
Dear customer,
Effective January 1, 2027, Quillon's payout fee will change to 0.40% per payout (minimum $0.25), with lower rates for monthly volumes above $5M. No action is needed on your side.

faits.texte: Says the results contradict each other on the Q1 payout fee (0.45% vs 0.40%).
Gives 0.45% as the most recent figure (Rachel in #sales, 17 November), cited first.
Says 0.40% comes from the earlier proposal v3 (and the draft customer notice).
The new fee takes effect on 1 January 2027.
Pinecrest was told 0.40% and Owen is to correct it.
Customer notices go out by 1 December.

interdits.texte: Gives 0.40% as the Q1 payout fee without signalling that a more recent message says 0.45%.
Says the pricing notice has been sent to customers.

pieges: Contradiction : la proposition v3, l'appel Gong et le brouillon d'avis (0,40 %) contre le message Slack plus récent (0,45 %) ; la réponse doit le dire, le plus récent d'abord.
Ordre : le premier résultat affiché est le document périmé.
Brouillon : l'avis aux clients est marqué « do not send », il n'est pas parti.
